site.hero_body: Let’s redesign your home together — creating refined spaces that reflect your lifestyle, crafted to your budget.
site.about_p1: I’m Husni — a London-based architect and project manager. BSc Architecture and currently completing my Masters in Project Management at the University of Westminster. Over four years and 6+ high-budget projects, I’ve learned that good architecture is equal parts care, clarity and craft.
site.about_p2: I work closely with homeowners across Greater London and the Home Counties — translating how you actually live into refined, beautifully detailed spaces, delivered on time and on budget.
site.about_story_p1: I grew up fascinated by the way buildings shape experience — how a well-considered room can make you feel calm, energised, or at home in a way you can’t quite articulate.
site.about_story_p2: Over the past four years I’ve worked on a range of projects across Greater London and beyond — from full residential renovations to institutional extensions and major civic infrastructure.
site.about_story_p3: I work with homeowners who care about quality, who want their space to reflect who they are, and who want a single trusted professional managing the entire process.
site.about_work_p1: Every project begins with listening. Before I pick up a pen or open Revit, I want to understand how you actually use your home — the morning routine, the entertaining, the quiet moments.
site.about_work_p2: I use BIM software (Revit + 3D visualisation) throughout the process so you can see exactly what you’re getting before anything is built.

site.tl2_title: Ansell HR & Finance — Seeduwa, Sri Lanka
site.tl2_desc: Lead drafter and 3D BIM modeller for 15,000 sq ft commercial interior refurbishment.
site.tl3_desc: Part of design team for World Bank-funded civic infrastructure project spanning 39,364 sqm.
site.val1_desc: No jargon, no surprises. You’ll always know where the project stands.
site.val2_desc: Details make the difference. I sweat the small stuff so you don’t have to.
site.val3_desc: I design to your budget, not around it. Good architecture doesn’t require unlimited funds.
site.cta_subtext: Initial consultations are always free and completely unhurried.
site.contact_subheading: Tell me a little about your home and what you’re trying to achieve. Initial consultations are always free and unhurried.

projects.title: Ansell HR & Finance
projects.description: A complete interior refurbishment — adaptive reuse of existing storage space for 100 HR & Finance employees. Included façade elevation, interior arrangement, lighting, electrical layout and plumbing.

projects.title: J’Pura Engineering Faculty
projects.description: Extension added to existing building as new wing. Façade designed with steel and glass mullions combined with brick to match existing building language. Currently under construction, due 2027.

projects.title: Nova Apartments
projects.description: Full interior design for residential apartment complex. Modern yet refined approach combining luxury materials with practical living. Bespoke furniture layouts, custom lighting design throughout.

projects.title: Kandy Multimodal Terminal
projects.description: Major civic infrastructure addressing public transport in Kandy. Designed to handle 330,000 passengers per day across 193 bus routes. Funded by The World Bank.

services.name: Home Renovation
services.description: Bespoke refurbishment of period and contemporary homes — seamlessly blending commission and full fit-out. I manage the entire process from design through planning to construction oversight.

services.name: New Build Design
services.description: Bespoke architectural design for new homes, from initial sketch through planning to detailed construction drawings. The design process begins with understanding the site and how you want to live.

services.name: 3D BIM Visualisation
services.description: Photorealistic BIM models so you can walk through your home before a single brick is laid. Built in Revit — explore material choices and lighting conditions before committing.

services.name: Space Planning
services.description: Layout strategy that makes every room feel larger, lighter and more aligned with how you actually live. I specialise in finding the hidden potential in existing floor plans.

services.name: Interior Design
services.description: Material palettes, furniture specification and lighting design — crafted to your taste and budget. From concept boards to bespoke joinery details, every element considered.

services.name: Planning & Approvals
services.description: Full planning application management — from pre-app advice through to decision and beyond. I know what planners respond to and how to present proposals persuasively.
